name: ❄️ Watch a TV!
desc:
ITEMS HAVE BEEN RESTORED FOR OLD PLAYERS! If you've played before the Rewrite Update, your items should have been automatically restored into your inventory! Sorry for all the troubles beforehand.

Welcome to Watch a TV! As the name suggests, watch some quality television or broadcast yourself on TV! Collect rare items, hang out with friends, or explore the open map!  

Private Servers allow you to change TV Channels for free!

Supported devices: Mobile, PC, VR (Console is so-so)

If you need help with anything such as purchases or information, post on the Blitzen Productions group forums! Staff will also check it ocassionally.

WE WILL PERMANENTLY BAN PLAYERS WHO BREAK ROBLOX'S TOS DUE TO AN AVATAR, CHAT LOGS, ETC. !!
